title: Mod Translation  ：Morathi: Corruption of a Handmaiden       Mod汉化：莫拉斯的腐化侍女，事务官 1.0.0
author: death13x
description:
Original author: Rat of the Lake

Original mod link: <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/24467-morathi-corruption-of-a-handmaiden/>

The translation and release have been approved by the original author. This translated mod is only available in the translation section of LoversLab and the Warhammer 3 section of 3dm. Please do not repost or use it for any commercial purposes. Uploading to Steam Workshop is prohibited.

To use it, please put the file in XXX\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III\data, and then enable it in the mod manager in the Warhammer 3 launcher. I have tested it for 40 turns and haven't encountered any problems. However, this agent is mainly intended to follow your army and is not designed for strolling around town. If she goes to the sea, she will become a T-pose model without a ship model, but it does not affect the use.

This hero is exclusive to Morathi. At the beginning of the game, Morathi will give you a quest to complete in order to obtain her. If you want to obtain her through normal means, you will need to restart the game. If you want to use her in other factions or in the middle of the game, please subscribe to the "console commands" mod in the Steam Workshop, find the mod in the game, and enter the "agent champion alivia_aina" command to obtain her.

This hero has a unique story and skill tree. As she levels up and unlocks skills with skill points, story events will occur, allowing you to understand what happened and change the hero model.

This mod is compatible with version 3.0.

As for the translation, I really liked this mod and spent a month translating it, finishing it just as version 3.0 was released. After I finished translating it, I looked at Discord and found that someone had already translated it. Oh well, that was silly of me. But my translation is integrated with the original file, so you don't need to download any other files to use it.

I also did some personal embellishments. Well, actually, I put in quite a bit of effort, especially with the pet storyline, which I expanded from 400 English words to over 2,000 Chinese characters. I'm quite proud of it.

That's all I can think of for now. If you have any questions, please message me.

原作者：Rat of the Lake

原mod地址：<https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/24467-morathi-corruption-of-a-handmaiden/>

汉化和发布已征求原作者同意，本汉化mod仅发布在loveslab的翻译区和3dm的战锤3分区，请勿转载或用于任何形势的商业行为，禁止上传steam创意工坊

使用请把该文件放在XXX\steamapps\common\Total War WARHAMMER III\data文件里，然后在锤3的启动器里的mod管理器启用即可，我测试了40个回合，没有遇到啥问题，就是这个事务官基本都是随军，没太考虑用来逛街的情况，如果她下海的话会变成T字模型，没有船的模型，不过不影响使用。

这个英雄是莫拉斯专属的，莫拉斯在开局的时候会给你一个任务，完成后即可获取，想正常手段获取需要重开游戏才行。如果其他派系或者游戏中途想要使用的话，请在创意工坊订阅“console commands” mod，然后在游戏里找到这个mod，输入“agent champion alivia_aina”命令即可获取。

独特的故事和技能线，这个英雄随等级提升用技能点解锁技能会出现故事事件，让你了解发生了什么，并且改变英雄模型，你懂的。

本mod已适配3.0版本

翻译的话：之前看到这个mod挺喜欢，磨磨蹭蹭做了一个月，到3.0都发布了才汉化完，我汉化都做完了然后看了眼discord发现已经有人汉化过了，啊，那可真蠢，想了想还是发出来了

不过我这个汉化是和原文件整合在一起的，不用额外下载其他文件配合

个人渣润色

好吧，其实还是稍微下了点功夫的，而且私人宠物线自觉合理的扩写了一点，尤其最后一段，400多英文词我扩写成2000多汉字，我可太得意了
